purpose: Compare compact response predictors; no WeKnora DB access or claim of causal learning gains.

ct.status: exploratory; previous test results already examined

as.status: additional held-out evaluation; schema audit precedes fitting

exclusions: multi-skill event; never broadcast one label to multiple skills
AS non-original or hinted first response when identifiable
ordering: CT timestamp then numeric row; AS order_id. AS order is an event proxy, not elapsed time.

history_logistic.fit: training; select lambda on validation log loss; no student intercept

history: Per-student histories reset across splits; predict before observing each current label. Within held-out students, prior observed labels are allowed for online state updates only.
selection: Lowest validation log loss among all candidates. Test never selects hyperparameters or model.

uncertainty.paired_difference: selected minus skill mean user macro log loss

transfer: Evaluate source-fitted shared history coefficients, global mean, and BKT on the other corpus with all target skill intercepts unknown; target outcomes only update previous-history features, never parameters. Report as stress test, not enterprise transfer evidence.
negative_control: Shuffle training labels with seed 20260912, rebuild all label-derived history features, refit history model using selected lambda, evaluate untouched test history. Report even if performance remains strong from skill frequencies.
deployment_gate: No public-corpus parameters deployed as local component mastery probabilities. Requires local independent outcome validation and content-quality review.
raw_data: Stored only under .local-data; publish aggregate results and hashes, not learner records.
schema_amendment: If dataset fields require a change, record it before computing outcome metrics; preserve this protocol and list amendments in results.
